g.text: Where Tailscale's packets go: the TUN device and userspace WireGuard
Swarm needs the normal mode, because it needs a real tailscale0 interface.
plaintext IP packet goes INTO the TUN device; encrypted UDP comes OUT through an ordinary socket
NO tailscale0 interface: the OS cannot route
normal traffic into Tailscale. Meant for places
In both modes WireGuard runs in USERSPACE (Tailscale uses its own wireguard-go fork). It is not the in-kernel WireGuard module.
